about: In the Varrock Museum's cleaning area beside Barnabus Hurma, carrying an old symbol and a clean necklace, with no Dig Site find on display and the necklace's secret not yet learnt.
notes: For test-runner/examples/museum-kudos-cases.json: the varbits are the 242 cache's vm_kudos (3637), vm_necklace (3639) and vm_digsite_* (3645-3649), set to 0 so a display case run can repeat on one account; ::reset puts them back. The scenario's start clears the saved charges, so the archaeologists forget sending the player to a case too.
